datasets.used_for: Seed training data for the fertilizer-type classifier (contract C4 CLASSIFIER_TARGET). Quantity and schedule come from ml/data/external/crop_nutrient_norms.csv and split_schedule.csv (PAU-sourced), not from this dataset.

datasets.description: Real SOTER soil-profile estimates for the Indo-Gangetic Plains (includes Punjab), 0-20cm depth
datasets.retrieval_method: Direct download of the public ISRIC SOTWIS_IGP-IN.zip archive; attribute table extracted from GIS/SOTWIS/SOTWIS_0-20cm_parametersestimates/IGP-IN_SOTWISv1_t1s1d1.dbf with dbfread. Geometry/shapefile discarded -- only the tabular soil-property attributes were kept.
datasets.used_for: Complementary reference only -- cross-checking realistic soil parameter ranges (pH, organic carbon proxy via total_carbon_pct, N%, EC) for the Punjab/Indo-Gangetic-Plains region. Polygon/map-unit level (1:1,000,000 scale), not per-field; not used as classifier training rows. Not filtered to Punjab specifically -- covers the whole Indo-Gangetic Plains (497 SOTER units), which includes Punjab but is not exclusive to it.

evaluated_not_ingested.description: IFA/FAO Fertilizer Use by Crop (FUBC) 2017-18 survey + historical collation, includes India (rice/wheat/cotton/sugarcane) at country level
evaluated_not_ingested.reason_not_ingested: License and structure fully verified (peer-reviewed in Nature Scientific Data, DOI 10.1038/s41597-022-01592-z), but the raw CSV download is behind an anti-bot challenge (Anubis/BotStopper) that this session's tools could not mechanically pass, and the in-browser preview truncates before reaching India alphabetically in the country-sorted file. Rather than fabricate India rows, this was left unfetched. Recommend a manual download by a teammate in a normal browser session for R3/R10 norm cross-checking.
